en: An aerial color photograph of a small town nestled in a green valley surrounded by forested hills. The scene shows clustered red‑roofed houses, a prominent church with a tall tower near the center, patchwork fields, winding rural roads, and a small river curving along the edge of the town. The style and color of the print resemble a mid‑20th‑century tourist postcard. No visible text appears on the image side.
